items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I had saved up my ration stamps and had a young girl working for me named Priscilla.

ctx.x: But she came back with something that looked like a corn on the -- one ear. I said, "What is this, Priscilla?" She says, "That's the corn on the cob." I said, "How come you only got one?" She didn't even know how to order. I said, "Well I'll tell you what you do. You eat this ear of corn because I'm going back where I can get all the corn." Oh boy!
So you were there quite a long time in '48.
